name: Colosseum Battle Environments
description: Colosseum Battle Environments 1.2 consolidates the current Gen 1/Gen 2 battle-environment runtime, adds per-battle RANDOM arena and RANDOM Colosseum music selection, restores the platform-neutral in-process MusyX source renderer, and supports validated Pokemon Colosseum USA GC6E01 ISO/GCM and GameCube CISO imports through Gen1Recomp required-import streaming. The release keeps the existing transition, Mt. Battle, trainer, camera, sprite-provider and external-mod compatibility fixes while removing the obsolete Windows-only audio executable path.

required_imports.name: Pokemon Colosseum (USA) Disc (ISO/CISO)
required_imports.description: Required CBE source. Select Pokemon Colosseum USA GC6E01 disc 0 revision 0 as a clean ISO/GCM or supported GameCube CISO. The launcher streams the selected file into persistent private storage; CBE reads CISO in place without expanding it to a 1.46 GiB ISO.
